                     Learning in Vision-Language Models

egories appear over time. This challenge becomes espe-                 formation tied to subtle intra-class variations. Prior works

Figure 2. Overview of our proposed framework. The residual features are mapped to indices corresponding to the closest code in each
of the subspace. These codes are used to extract embeddings from HPE lookup table followed by cross-attention to incorporate intricate
details among these subspaces. Prompt composer then composes these subspace embeddings into a meaningful prompt using learnable
query based self-attention.
